SELECT g,STDEV(n) AS stdev,STDEVP(n) AS stdevp,VAR(n) AS var,VARP(n) AS varp FROM (VALUES (1,1,CAST('1' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(2,1,CAST('2' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(3,1,CAST('2' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(4,2,CAST('1000000000000' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(5,2,CAST('1000000000001' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(6,2,CAST('1000000000002' AS DECIMAL(20,0)))) s(id,g,n) GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

SELECT id,STDEV(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS stdev,STDEVP(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS stdevp,VAR(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS var,VARP(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS varp FROM (VALUES (1,CAST('1' AS INT)),(2,CAST('2' AS INT)),(3,CAST('2' AS INT)),(4,CAST('9' AS INT))) s(id,n) ORDER BY id

SELECT id,STDEV(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS stdev,STDEVP(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS stdevp,VAR(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS var,VARP(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS varp FROM (VALUES (1,CAST('9' AS INT)),(2,CAST('2' AS INT)),(3,CAST('2' AS INT)),(4,CAST('1' AS INT))) s(id,n) ORDER BY id

SELECT id,STDEV(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS stdev,STDEVP(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS stdevp,VAR(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS var,VARP(n) OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS varp FROM (VALUES (1,CAST(NULL AS INT)),(2,CAST('1' AS INT)),(3,CAST('2' AS INT)),(4,CAST('2' AS INT)),(5,CAST('9' AS INT))) s(id,n) ORDER BY id

SELECT id,STDEV(n) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS stdev,STDEVP(n) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS stdevp,VAR(n) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS var,VARP(n) OVER (PARTITION BY g ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS varp FROM (VALUES (1,1,CAST('1' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(2,1,CAST('2' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(3,1,CAST('2' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(4,2,CAST('1000000000000' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(5,2,CAST('1000000000001' AS DECIMAL(20,0))),(6,2,CAST('1000000000002' AS DECIMAL(20,0)))) s(id,g,n) ORDER BY id
